headline_real: Meta and EssilorLuxottica launch new 'Meta Glasses' AI eyewear line starting at $299
facts: Launched June 23, 2026 starting at $299 — about $80 cheaper than Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2
Three styles: Meta Adventurer, Meta Fury, and Meta Glasses by Kylie (Kylie Jenner collab, from ~$399)
Runs Meta AI on the new Muse Spark model, 12MP ultrawide camera, 8+ hours battery plus 40 hours from the charging case
New Rx Lens Swap lets buyers add prescription lenses after purchase without voiding warranty; sold across 17 markets via Meta.com, LensCrafters, Sunglass Hut, Best Buy and Amazon

headline_real: visionOS 27 gives Apple Vision Pro a spatial computing and Apple Intelligence upgrade
facts: Announced at WWDC 2026; adds Spatial Panoramas that convert flat panoramas into stepable 3D environments
New Spatial Siri 3D widget enables hands-free AI interaction with no wake word
Adds Spatial Reframing AI photo editing, curved app windows, a Mac Virtual Display widget and Wi-Fi 3x faster
Apple Intelligence gains contextual understanding of objects seen through passthrough, plus 360-degree web experiences in Safari

headline_real: Google and Samsung confirm Android XR glasses launching Fall 2026 with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster
facts: Google and Samsung officially teased first Android XR glasses styles for a Fall 2026 launch
Eyewear partners are Warby Parker and Gentle Monster for fashion-forward frames
Gemini-powered: real-time translation, navigation, restaurant ordering, summarized notifications and hands-free photo capture
Audio-first frames ship first; full-display versions expected to follow in 2027

headline_real: Snap brings AI Lenses to luxury fashion as Gucci launches 'La Famiglia' Sponsored AI Lens
facts: Gucci's 'La Famiglia' is the first Sponsored AI Lens for a luxury fashion brand, powered by Snapchat's generative AI
Transforms users into collection-based character personas (L'Incazzata, Direttore, La VIP, Il Figo, Principino)
Snap says ~90% of 13-24-year-olds globally use the app and ~80% of users report AR experiences help purchase decisions
Follows Snap's 2025 holiday luxury push with Chopard, BOSS and Lancome; Gen Z projected to be 25%+ of global luxury spend within four years
